comment: Liquidity structures (cash pools) at each month-end from Apr-2023: notional pooling, physical pooling, sweeps and interest optimisation set up for multi-entity client groups, one row per member account (the header account and every participant account live at the month-end) with the member's country, currency, role and month-end balance, the structure attributes (type, header account / country, pooling currency, sweep frequency, cross-border flag, interest benefit, monthly fee) and the estimated interest saved. Structures = count distinct structure_id (or SUM(is_header)); Participants = count of rows with role Participant; Pooled Balance = SUM of member_balance_usd at one month-end (POINT-IN-TIME: never sum balances across months). interest_saved_usd and monthly_fee_usd are monthly flows (the fee sits on the header row only). Grain: one row per liquidity structure per member account (header or participant) per month-end while the structure is active.
